_readme: Every tunable parameter for the NeuroDrive bridge. See config.README.md for what each field does. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by the loader.

eeg._source: serial = real MindWave over Bluetooth SPP | mock = synthetic signal, no hardware | replay = play back a recorded CSV

blink_from_raw._note: Optional fallback if the headset does not emit 0x16 blink rows.

vision._readme: Webcam gesture input. The user raises a hand, the vehicle turns that way. Needs mediapipe and the model in models/. Set control.turn_source to vision or both to actually use it.
vision._raise_margin: How far above the shoulder the wrist must be, as a fraction of frame height. Raise it if a resting hand triggers turns.
vision._hold_frames: Consecutive frames a raise must persist before it counts. Raise it if a hand passing through the frame fires a turn.
vision._repeat_while_held_ms: 0 = one raise, one turn. Above 0, holding the arm up repeats the turn this often.
vision._swap_sides: Set true only if the turns come out inverted. MediaPipe labels landmarks anatomically, so it should not be needed.

control._turn_source: blink = turn on eye blinks (default) | vision = turn on raised hands | both
control._hold_turn_while_raised: true = the vehicle keeps turning for as long as the hand stays up, and straightens when it comes down. false = one raise gives one turn pulse of turn_command_repeat_ms.
control._blink_mode: alternate = each blink turns the other way | single_double = one blink LEFT, two blinks RIGHT

transport._mode: udp = wireless (primary) | serial = USB cable to ESP32 (fallback)
transport._invert_turns: Set true when the vehicle turns the opposite way to the command, e.g. pressing 'a' steers it right. Applied to the outgoing byte only, so it corrects blink, webcam and keyboard turns together.
